title: Foundations of Creativity — What It Is and Why It Matters

lo.statement: Define creativity and explain its importance and role in business problem-solving.
Distinguish creativity from innovation and explain how creative thinking leads to innovation in business.
Describe the stages of the creative process, from idea generation through to implementation.
Identify personal and organisational barriers to creativity and apply techniques to overcome mental blocks and traditional thinking.

active_learning.desc: Brainstorm ideas to redesign a basic mobile app or website and create a creative solution.
